# TBILISI WEAR

> Minimalist luxury fashion house from Tbilisi. Curated clothing and accessories for men and women, designed and crafted to last.

TBILISI WEAR is an independent fashion label offering a curated edit of premium pieces. The website is an e-commerce store with collections for women and men, brand pages, seasonal sales, and editorial content.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, featured collections, and current campaigns.
- [Shop](/shop): Full product catalog across all categories.
- [Women](/women): Women's collection — ready-to-wear and accessories.
- [Men](/men): Men's collection — ready-to-wear and accessories.
- [Brands](/brands): Designers and labels stocked at TBILISI WEAR.
- [Bundles](/bundles): Curated multi-item bundles at a reduced price.
- [Sale](/sale): Current markdowns and seasonal discounts.
- [Flash Sale](/flash-sale): Limited-time, time-boxed promotions.
- [About](/about): Brand story, philosophy, and craft.
- [Contact](/contact): Customer care, wholesale, and press contact.
- [FAQ](/faq): Shipping, returns, sizing, and ordering questions.

## Optional

- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Terms of sale and website use.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How customer data is handled.
